name: Gemini
summary: Gemini is a Suzhou-based developer of humanoid robots for industrial applications. Known in Chinese as Shuangzi Zhiqing, the company was established in 2025 through Suzhou BEST and combines industrial motion control with an AI decision system. Its product portfolio includes the GeminiBot A1 wheeled humanoid, alongside robotic arms, core components and application systems. The company targets manufacturing tasks with a planned progression into commercial and household environments.
